## computeMaxSupplySharePrice() function

Computes the maximum supply share price (in RAY, 1e27) for slippage protection.

Mirrors the on-chain check in GeneralAdapter1's `morphoSupply`<!-- -->:

```solidity
require(suppliedAssets.rDivUp(suppliedShares) <= maxSharePriceE27)
```
Caps at [MAX\_ABSOLUTE\_SHARE\_PRICE](./morpho-sdk.max_absolute_share_price.md) to prevent absurd values on extreme markets.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare function computeMaxSupplySharePrice(params: {
    supplyAssets: bigint;
    market: Market;
    slippageTolerance: bigint;
}): bigint;
```

## Exceptions

`ExcessiveSlippageToleranceError` when `slippageTolerance >= WAD`<!-- -->.

`ShareDivideByZeroError` when expected shares round down to zero.

## Remarks

Parameter details:

- `params.supplyAssets`<!-- -->: The amount of loan assets to supply.

- `params.market`<!-- -->: The market to compute the maximum supply share price for.

- `params.slippageTolerance`<!-- -->: Slippage tolerance in WAD (e.g. `0.003e18` = 0.3%).
